bull_bear_summary.bull_case: Dominant global index franchise with powerful network effects and high client lock-in (93.4% retention). Revenue grew from $1.7B (2020) to $3.13B (2025) with 11 consecutive years of double-digit adj EPS growth (~14% FY2025). BlackRock ETF license extended to 2035 reinforces distribution moat. Record AUM-linked fee run rate ($852M, +26% YoY). Reverse DCF implies market pricing in 15.2% FCF CAGR — achievable given track record. CEO insider buying signals confidence. ~12% annual EPS growth projected through 2029.
bull_bear_summary.bear_case: Valuation stretched at 32x forward P/E, PEG >2.5x. AlphaSpread base case shows 20% overvaluation at ~$542. Competition from rival index providers (S&P/FTSE Russell) and fintech disruptors could erode pricing power. ESG regulatory backlash and investor skepticism may undermine MSCI's ESG/Climate product line (already showing retention softness). Revenue growth moderating. Heavy exposure to AUM-linked fees creates procyclicality — market downturn would compress asset-based revenue (~26% of total). Subscription retention dipped from 94.7% (Q3) to 93.4% (FY2025).
